context: Data container for a portion of the world at a specific level of detail.
description: Stores terrain, climate, river and vegetation information for a tile; used by streaming and rendering systems.

structs.name: MapTile
structs.description: Represents a region of the world in the quadtree.

fields.name: seedLocal
fields.description: Local seed derived from the global seed and tile coordinates.

fields.name: lodLevel
fields.description: Level of detail index (0 = macro, 1 = regional, 2 = local).

fields.name: heightField
fields.description: Height values sampled or generated for this tile.

fields.name: rivers
fields.description: River splines or graph segments intersecting the tile.

fields.name: vegetation
fields.description: Vegetation instances or density map for the tile.

pseudocode: Tile is created by sampling macro data and generating fine details; acts as a unit of streaming.
